g.text: truST Control Studio: Reused Runtime And Simulation Flow
Raw recordings and the accepted result
The runtime owns start, abort, timeout and restore.
Relay plans carry PV thresholds, not a timed trajectory;
the runtime changes output only from fresh measured PV.
Project-scripted plans write only their declared BOOL authority;
the lesson remains the sole owner of its process excitation.
Reload recovery polls the same experiment identity;
it never starts a second excitation.
The loop binding declares closed-loop or open-loop topology.
Open-loop lessons omit SP and error instead of synthesizing either;
both topologies reuse this monitor and process-image stream.
Physical excitation and controller apply require
one synchronized declared primary + auxiliary snapshot
